title: AIDLC: AI-Driven Software Development Lifecycle
description: Founded and led Bread Financial's AI-driven software development lifecycle initiative — set the vision and roadmap, built a cross-functional team spanning engineering, risk, cyber, and architecture, and delivered the company's first working proof of concept.

title: GenAI Quality Engineering & Test Data Management Portal
description: Directed GenAI-powered Quality Engineering upgrades including automated test case generation, tagging, and selective execution; launched a Test Data Management portal processing hundreds of requests per month.

title: Mainframe-to-Cloud Migration
description: Stabilized and operationalized systems following Bread Financial's largest migration of credit card processing off a mainframe platform to Fiserv and Microsoft Azure, cutting Fiserv transaction volume 20-25% through API caching and circuit breaker patterns.

title: BreadFinancial.com & NFLExtraPoints.com Launch
description: Led the technical delivery of BreadFinancial.com and NFLExtraPoints.com on a new Adobe Experience Manager platform, anchoring the company's brand transformation and the digital build of its first card program on the American Express network.

title: PartnerPortal
description: Led IT delivery of PartnerPortal, Bread Financial's Salesforce-based brand partner platform, growing adoption to over 100 active brands.

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Rollout
description: Spearheaded a $3.5M multi-factor authentication rollout at Nationwide that strengthened security for 1.5M+ online accounts.
